answer: An identity must show multisig participation: the agent must be a signer on a multisig wallet with a real history of transactions, verified on-chain. A quartz crystal grows slowly, and a multisig history is the same: it cannot be created overnight. The nebula of a farm's multisigs is a cloud of fresh wallets, all created last month, all with the same signers, all with no real transactions. The trellis of a real multisig is built over years: many signers, many transactions, many decisions, and the chain records every one of them.
